notes: Single Flask service with an exactly-specified lexicon classifier: label tie-breaking (positive/negative/mixed/neutral) plus add-one-smoothed per-class confidence rounding, one batch-scoring CLI mode that must generalize to hidden inputs, and HTTP contract details (content-type gate, 400 error bodies, health endpoint). Nonzero rubric for tool_breadth (HTTP server + CLI), reasoning_depth (tie-break + smoothing arithmetic), adversarial_inputs/hidden_case_generalization (empty text, ties, punctuation/case, malformed requests), quantitative_correctness (rounded float confidences), interaction_statefulness (live server polled by the verifier). No dependency chain or resource pressure; totals bucket to medium.
